_metadata.description: Erasmus University Rotterdam Library database access list
_metadata.source: Compiled from libguides.eur.nl, eur.nl/library, EDSC news, and manual verification
_metadata.maintainer: Update manually when database access changes. Check eur.nl/en/library/research-support/edsc/edsc-news for updates.

databases.name: WRDS (Wharton Research Data Services)
databases.notes: Primary platform for many financial databases. Requires EUR account registration.

databases.name: Compustat Global
databases.notes: International company fundamentals. Access via WRDS.

databases.name: Compustat North America
databases.notes: US/Canada company fundamentals, annual reports, credit ratings, index constituents.

databases.name: CRSP (Center for Research in Security Prices)
databases.notes: US stock prices, returns, and indices.

databases.name: CRSP Treasury
databases.notes: US Treasury bond data.

databases.name: I/B/E/S (Institutional Brokers' Estimate System)
databases.notes: Analyst earnings forecasts and recommendations.

databases.name: ExecuComp
databases.notes: Executive compensation data for S&P 1500 firms.

databases.name: BoardEx
databases.notes: Board of directors, executive profiles, and network connections.

databases.name: ISS (Institutional Shareholder Services)
databases.notes: Corporate governance, director data, voting analytics.

databases.name: OptionMetrics
databases.notes: Options prices, implied volatility, Greeks.

databases.name: Mergent FISD
databases.notes: Fixed Income Securities Database - corporate bond characteristics.

databases.name: Thomson Reuters Ownership
databases.notes: Institutional holdings (13F filings).

databases.name: People Intelligence
databases.notes: Executive and board member information.

databases.name: S&P Transcripts
databases.notes: Earnings call transcripts. License active until August 2026.

databases.name: PitchBook
databases.notes: Private market data (startups, PE, VC). Access expires November 2025.

databases.name: Revelio Labs
databases.notes: Labor market and workforce analytics. Trial access expires June 2026.

databases.name: RavenPack
databases.notes: News sentiment and analytics. License ended March 2025. Data must be purged per agreement.

databases.name: LSEG Workspace (formerly Eikon/Datastream)
databases.notes: Room Y1-7 (Polak Building) - 10 terminals, no reservation. Also available via virtual machines. 2-hour daily limit.

databases.name: SDC Platinum
databases.notes: M&A, IPOs, joint ventures, alliances. Access via LSEG Workspace.

databases.name: Orbis (Bureau van Dijk)
databases.notes: Global company information, financials, ownership structures.

databases.name: Morningstar Direct
databases.notes: Mutual funds, ETFs, open-end and closed-end funds. Booking required for VM access.

databases.name: Bloomberg Terminal
databases.notes: Bloomberg license cancelled April 2024 due to budget cuts. Use LSEG Workspace as alternative.

databases.name: EBSCO Business Source Complete
databases.notes: Business journals, articles, and ebooks.

databases.name: JSTOR
databases.notes: Academic journals archive.

databases.name: Web of Science
databases.notes: Citation database and journal rankings.

databases.name: Scopus
databases.notes: Abstract and citation database.

databases.name: ProQuest
databases.notes: Dissertations, theses, newspapers, and journals.

databases.name: Statista
databases.notes: Statistics and market data across industries.

databases.name: OECD iLibrary
databases.notes: OECD publications, statistics, and datasets.

databases.name: Eurostat
databases.notes: European Union statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: World Bank Open Data
databases.notes: Development indicators. Publicly available.

databases.name: IMF Data
databases.notes: International financial statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: CBS StatLine
databases.notes: Netherlands official statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: SEC EDGAR
databases.notes: US company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements). Publicly available.

databases.name: SSRN
databases.notes: Working papers and preprints. Publicly available.

databases.name: Eventus (via WRDS)
databases.notes: Event study software using CRSP data.

databases.name: TAQ (Trade and Quote)
databases.notes: Intraday trades and quotes for US equities.

databases.name: RiskMetrics
databases.notes: Risk management datasets.

databases.name: EBSCO Business eBook Collection
databases.notes: Trial access until November 2026.

databases.name: Harvard Business eBook Collection
databases.notes: Harvard Business Review Press collection. Trial until November 2026.

databases.name: Knowledgestore (Markets and Markets)
databases.notes: Market research on high-growth niche markets.

databases.name: Portfolio Management Research
databases.notes: Finance and investment publications.

databases.name: South African Newspaper Archive
databases.notes: Historical South African newspapers (Rand Daily Mail, Sunday Times, Sowetan).

not_available.name: FactSet
not_available.notes: Not available at EUR. No subscription.

not_available.name: Capital IQ
not_available.notes: Not confirmed at EUR. Some data may be available via Compustat/WRDS.

not_available.name: Sustainalytics
not_available.notes: Not confirmed at EUR. Check LSEG Workspace for ESG data alternatives.

not_available.name: Audit Analytics
not_available.notes: Not found in EUR database access. Verify with EDSC.

not_available.name: Preqin
not_available.notes: Subscription discontinued March 15, 2025 due to budget cuts. PitchBook via WRDS is alternative (until Nov 2025).
